ui-indicators.reason: Noninteractive UI status/count badges share surrounding UI proportions. Explicit size wins; PresenceDot maps xs to sm; two-rung UnreadBadge/EnergyBadge map xs/sm to sm and md/lg to md. Semantic status/rating colors remain independent of scope tone.
ui-indicators.verification: mock-rendered native and DOM web: default, nearest, explicit, nested, wrappers, actual portal; physical layout and device accessibility pending; Chromium actual geometry and accessible-name attributes: 16 hosts across xs/sm/md/lg plus explicit md, light/dark at 390/1100 CSS px (4 scenarios)

code-document.reason: CodeLines size selects code typography/line-number metrics (sm 11/18, md 13/23), not chrome or touch targets. CodeBlock passes its content size deliberately; surrounding control scope must not silently rewrite source-code reading density.
code-document.verification: native mock and DOM web verify independent defaults under xs/lg control scopes and explicit document/artwork sizes; physical-device rendering pending

markdown-document.reason: Markdown size sets a whole document reading recipe (body, heading hierarchy and block spacing). Its MarkdownProvider passes that explicit document size to blocks. A compact toolbar is not permission to shrink document text.
markdown-document.verification: native mock and DOM web verify independent defaults under xs/lg control scopes and explicit document/artwork sizes; physical-device rendering pending

audio-art.reason: AudioWaveVisualizer size sets waveform amplitude box/bar thickness (heights 24/40/72). It is hidden decorative signal artwork with data-driven levels, not a control or a status-label typography recipe. Keep explicit artwork dimensions rather than making control scope alter signal amplitude geometry.
audio-art.verification: native mock and DOM web verify independent defaults under xs/lg control scopes and explicit document/artwork sizes; physical-device rendering pending

scrollbar-visual.reason: ScrollBar's size prop is scrollbar thumb thickness on web (sm 4px, md 6px), not Bloom control size; the hit strip adds 6px without taking content space. Native renders no overlay and leaves the operating system indicator to its ScrollView. Native and web runtime tests verify the control scope cannot change this role-specific geometry and the explicit web size remains effective.
scrollbar-visual.verification: native renderer returns no overlay for xs/lg scopes and sm/md thickness props; web measures track/thumb at 10/4px for sm and 12/6px for md under both xs and lg scopes; actual native platform indicator appearance remains OS-owned

button-delegation.reason: Each named Button composition renders the shared Button with the complete props spread and no size default. Both native/web implementations delegate size precedence directly; appearance/tone/iconOnly defaults do not consume or replace size.
button-delegation.verification: all nine public Button compositions render on native and DOM web; xs from nearest BloomScope and explicit lg override are measured for boxed wrappers and LinkButton typography; default/nested/portal matrix remains pending

glyph-art.reason: Published SVG glyph components paint an explicitly supplied numeric width/height/fill or icon-token size. The consuming control owns control geometry; a glyph is not a second control-size owner.
glyph-art.verification: source classification of glyph contracts; glyph-specific visual regression not implied

accordion-root-part.reason: Accordion accepts an explicit size override and applies it through BloomScope to its entire compound tree; when omitted, the nearest caller scope remains in force. The renderer keeps state/interaction ownership separate from visual context.
accordion-root-part.verification: native mock and RNW DOM verify default md, inherited xs, nested xs then lg, and explicit root sm over inherited lg; descendants receive the resolved scope; physical-device layout pending

accordion-item-part.reason: AccordionItem owns disclosure state membership and a semantic divider, not a size recipe. Its child trigger/content remain under the nearest BloomScope and resolve their own geometry.
accordion-item-part.verification: native mock and RNW DOM exercise the actual AccordionItem > AccordionTrigger/AccordionContent composition under default md, inherited xs, nested xs/lg, and explicit root sm; physical-device layout pending

accordion-trigger-part.reason: AccordionTrigger is an interactive disclosure control. Its typography, vertical padding, icon and gap now follow the inherited or explicit Accordion size recipe while preserving the established md geometry.
accordion-trigger-part.verification: native mock and RNW DOM measure md 15/12/8px, xs 12/8/6px, sm 13/10/8px and lg 17/14/10px typography/padding/gap under inherited, nested and explicit sizes; native touch renderer keeps 44px minimum height; physical-device target fit pending

accordion-content-part.reason: AccordionContent owns measured disclosure-body spacing. Its trailing padding follows the same inherited size scale so the animated content measurement stays aligned with the trigger recipe.
accordion-content-part.verification: native mock measures body padding at xs 8px, sm 10px, md 12px and lg 14px; RNW DOM verifies the matching size-specific body CSS recipe under inherited, nested and explicit sizes; physical-device layout pending

pending.reason: Public React identity and prop vocabulary are enumerated, but per-part applicability/delegation and complete runtime matrix have not yet been audited. Family hook imports and transitive reachability grant no conformance.
pending.verification: pending; not a passing adoption verdict

navigation-layout.reason: PageHeader, TabBar and BottomBar own screen chrome, measured edge claims, safe areas and expanded/minimized navigation geometry, not a canonical control-size prop. Preserve those role-specific layout recipes; their separately exported controls/parts still need their own applicability audit. Native and web runtime tests verify the fixed header/tab/navigation dimensions remain stable under xs and lg BloomScope; fixed chrome dimensions do not establish that targets inside or surrounding controls meet touch contracts.
navigation-layout.verification: mock-rendered native styles and DOM-computed web styles compare PageHeader navigation min-height 44, TabBar pill height 58 and BottomBar height 74 under xs and lg BloomScope; physical layout, control proportions and target matrix pending

historical-scope-regression.reason: These are the size-consuming parts repaired in #417, not new gaps inferred from the historical family table. The existing web regression checks defaults, inherited rungs, nested scopes and explicit overrides; Tooltip content parts also cross their real web portal. Keep each existing recipe and partial mapping.
historical-scope-regression.verification: existing web scope regressions rerun; native family regressions rerun but complete per-part native scope/portal and device matrix remains pending

external-router-parts.reason: Expo Router Link static parts are forwarded by Object.assign in the router adapter. Their declarations and implementations belong to the external package; inclusion records the public contract, not BloomScope adoption or a Bloom-owned implementation. Each part still needs semantic and platform review.
external-router-parts.verification: Type-resolved native/web routes and declaration provenance only; external runtime behavior and size semantics remain unaudited

canvas-layout-parts.reason: Canvas, CanvasBackground and CanvasPanel own viewport, background and panel layout, not a control-size prop. They preserve the surrounding BloomScope for caller-provided controls; CanvasPanel's snap handle keeps its separately defined role and platform touch target. Explicit size on child controls still wins.
canvas-layout-parts.verification: Native renderer and RNW DOM measure child Button geometry through Canvas, CanvasBackground and CanvasPanel: default md, inherited sm, nested lg and explicit md; ordinary wrappers plus native and web body portals. Device-rendered proportions, panel touch targets and full responsive behavior remain pending

multi-agent-preview-parts.reason: SelectedAgentPreview owns a fixed 160×112px artwork viewport; avatar diameter and position are selected by participant count (80px for one, 62px for two or three, 48px for four or more), not by control size. It has no size prop, and its caption uses the standard Text family. Evidence: src/multi-agent-chat/SelectedAgentPreview.tsx, src/__tests__/SelectedAgentPreviewPublicPartScope.test.tsx, src/__tests__/SelectedAgentPreviewPublicPartScope.web.test.tsx. Both platform routes measure the viewport and each rendered avatar at counts 1, 2, 3 and 4 with no scope, xs, and nested xs/lg scopes; physical-device fit and responsive footprint remain pending.
multi-agent-preview-parts.verification: native renderer and RNW DOM measure the 160×112px viewport and count-specific 80/62/48px avatar geometry for 1/2/3/4 agents under no scope, xs and nested xs/lg scopes; device fit and responsive footprint pending

agent-creator-field-parts.reason: AgentCreatorField owns a details-card row and 96px label column but has no size prop or control recipe; its caller-provided control remains a child and inherits the surrounding BloomScope. The label uses the standard Text family. Evidence: src/agent-creator/AgentCreatorField.tsx, src/__tests__/AgentCreatorPublicPartScope.test.tsx, src/__tests__/AgentCreatorPublicPartScope.web.test.tsx. Native and RNW verify default md, inherited sm, nested lg and explicit md child Button geometry, including a body portal from the companion section; responsive row wrapping and physical-device layout remain pending.
agent-creator-field-parts.verification: mock-rendered native and DOM web measure child Button geometry through the field at default md, inherited sm, nested lg and explicit md, plus a real web body portal; responsive wrapping and device verification pending

agent-creator-section-parts.reason: AgentCreatorSection owns the titled card surface and spacing but has no size prop or control recipe; caller-provided rows remain children and inherit the surrounding BloomScope. Its title uses the standard Text family. Evidence: src/agent-creator/AgentCreatorSection.tsx, src/__tests__/AgentCreatorPublicPartScope.test.tsx, src/__tests__/AgentCreatorPublicPartScope.web.test.tsx. Native and RNW verify default md, inherited sm, nested lg and explicit md child Button geometry, including a real portal; responsive section overflow and physical-device layout remain pending.
agent-creator-section-parts.verification: mock-rendered native and DOM web measure child Button geometry at default md, inherited sm, nested lg and explicit md through the section; native and web portal behavior exercised; responsive overflow and device verification pending

admonition-parts.reason: Admonition uses shared proportions. Admonition and AdmonitionRoot establish the explicit-or-inherited BloomScope size; xs/sm/md/lg map to measured padding, row gap, icon, content gap and text recipes. AdmonitionButton delegates to Button and preserves its explicit size override. Type tint and outline semantics remain independent.
admonition-parts.verification: Native-renderer and DOM web tests cover default md, nearest xs, explicit root sm over outer lg, nested lg, explicit Button sm over nested lg, composed parts through Portal, and the one-piece Admonition explicit lg. Submenus do not apply to this family; physical device layout and accessibility remain unverified.

address-item-scope.reason: AddressList and AddressRow consume BloomScope size for tiles, type, local list spacing, and loading/empty states. Their content density is a separate axis and resolves explicit density, then BloomScope contentDensity, then comfortable; AddressRow delegates row structure to Item. Item preserves legacy density while its new contentDensity axis leaves control size and touch targets independent.
address-item-scope.verification: Native-renderer and DOM web tests cover default md, inherited xs, explicit list sm over lg, explicit entry lg over list xs, nested sm badge size, portal action inheritance, compact content density under lg, Item contentDensity inheritance, explicit comfortable override over compact scope and legacy density, xs loading geometry, and lg empty geometry. Physical-device layout remains unverified; submenus do not apply.

button-group-parts.reason: ButtonGroup resolves a size recipe for the joined control and provides that resolved size to its items; ButtonGroupItem can override the group size and owns the segment geometry. Scope therefore applies to both public parts, with explicit group and item sizes retaining precedence.
button-group-parts.verification: Native renderer and DOM web verify default md, inherited xs, lg scope clamped to md, explicit group md over xs, explicit item xs over group md, nested xs/lg scopes, and actual Portal inheritance; physical-device layout and touch fit remain unverified.

button-core.reason: Button owns the semantic control size recipe, including target geometry, typography and touch accommodation. Size scope applies to this control; the shared native/web implementations resolve the same public precedence.
button-core.verification: Native renderer and DOM web verify default md (36px), inherited sm (32px), explicit md over inherited sm, nested lg (44px), and inherited/explicit geometry through Canvas, CanvasBackground, CanvasPanel, and actual Portal. Direct size tables verify xs/sm/md/lg geometry and touch accommodation; device-rendered fit and accessibility remain separate.
